name: Example Biologics Discovery
description: Example portfolio on synthetic data. Shares a registry with Example Biologics Development and takes only its research slice; the registry's development gate code is kept as source_stage but does not place the program.

feeds.sql:
WITH reg(code, name, project_type, modality, status, gate, target) AS (VALUES
    ('EXB-101', 'Anti-IL-X antibody', 'Research', 'mAb', 'Active', '3', 'IL-X'),
    ('EXB-102', 'T-cell engager', 'Research', 'Bispecific', 'Active', NULL, 'CD3 x TAA-1'),
    ('EXB-103', 'Receptor trap', 'Research', 'Fusion protein', 'On Hold', NULL, 'RTK-2'),
    ('EXB-104', 'Anti-TS antibody', 'Research', 'mAb', 'Nominated', NULL, 'TS-4'),
    ('EXB-105', 'Anti-OX antibody', 'Research', 'mAb', 'Active', NULL, 'OX-5'),
    ('EXB-104', 'Anti-TS antibody', 'Development', 'mAb', 'Active', 'Gate D1', 'TS-4'),
    ('EXB-105', 'Anti-OX antibody', 'Development', 'mAb', 'Active', 'D1', 'OX-5'),
    ('EXB-201', 'Antibody Alpha', 'Development', 'mAb', 'Active', 'GD4', 'ALP-1'),
    ('EXB-202', 'Bispecific Beta', 'Development', 'Bispecific', 'Active', 'D2', 'BET-2'),
    ('EXB-203', 'Conjugate Gamma', 'Development', 'ADC', 'On Hold', 'D5', 'GAM-3'),
    ('EXB-204', 'Antibody Delta', 'Commercial', 'mAb', 'Active', 'D7', 'DEL-4'),
    ('EXB-205', 'Fusion Epsilon', 'Development', 'Fusion protein', 'Active', 'Gate 9z', 'EPS-5'),
    ('EXB-301', 'Small molecule Zeta', 'Development', 'Small Molecule', 'Active', 'D3', 'ZET-6'),
    ('EXB-302', 'Unclassified Eta', NULL, NULL, 'Active', NULL, NULL))
SELECT code, name, status, modality, gate AS source_stage, target FROM reg
WHERE project_type = 'Research' AND modality IS NOT NULL AND modality <> 'Small Molecule'
